lines.en: Rui, this exhibition is so popular that the queue went around the corner. I nearly gave up.
lines.pt: Rui, esta exposição é tão popular que a fila deu a volta na esquina. Quase desisti.

lines.en: I know, Dirk. It was such a long wait that I bought a coffee and read a whole chapter of my book.
lines.pt: Eu sei, Dirk. Foi uma espera tão longa que comprei um café e li um capítulo inteiro do meu livro.

lines.en: Worth it, though. Look at that statue. It looks as if it could start walking at any moment.
lines.pt: Valeu a pena, porém. Olhe aquela estátua. Parece que ela pode começar a andar a qualquer momento.

lines.en: Amazing. The guide speaks as though she had known the sculptor personally.
lines.pt: Incrível. A guia fala como se tivesse conhecido pessoalmente o escultor.

lines.en: Ha! She is such a passionate speaker that nobody checks the dates. Anyway, this hall is too dark for me to read the labels.
lines.pt: Ha! Ela é uma oradora tão apaixonada que ninguém confere as datas. Enfim, este salão é escuro demais para eu ler as legendas.

lines.en: Use the audio guide. The volume is loud enough for you to hear it even in a crowd.
lines.pt: Use o audioguia. O volume é alto o bastante para você ouvir mesmo na multidão.

lines.en: Good idea. Did you see the child near the door? He was too short to see the display, so his father lifted him.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Você viu a criança perto da porta? Era baixa demais para ver a vitrine, então o pai a levantou.

lines.en: Lovely. It was such a sweet moment that I took a photo.
lines.pt: Lindo. Foi um momento tão fofo que tirei uma foto.

lines.en: Careful, the guard is standing so close that he can see your screen. He looks as if he is about to say something.
lines.pt: Cuidado, o segurança está tão perto que consegue ver sua tela. Ele parece que está prestes a dizer algo.

lines.en: You are right. I will delete it now. I have not paid enough attention to the rules today, and I feel embarrassed.
lines.pt: Tem razão. Vou apagar agora. Não prestei atenção suficiente às regras hoje, e estou constrangido.

lines.en: Do not worry. Let us visit the shop before we go. The postcards are so cheap that I want to buy ten.
lines.pt: Não se preocupe. Vamos à loja antes de ir. Os cartões-postais são tão baratos que quero comprar dez.

facts.big: revisão: so, such, too, enough, as if
facts.label: Resultados e reações
facts.sub: so… that, such a… that, too… to, enough… to, as if.

facts.label: so… that, such a… that
facts.sub: So + adjetivo e such + substantivo, com that, mostram a consequência: The queue was so long that I left. It was such a long wait that I read a chapter.

facts.label: too dark to read
facts.sub: Too + adjetivo + to mostra excesso: The hall is too dark to read the labels. Se houver outra pessoa, use for: too dark for me to read.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Such a long wait that… is correct.
Too dark to read means there was enough light.
items.why: It means there was not enough light.

items.s: Loud enough to hear means loud in a sufficient way.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Such a long wait that… is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Too dark to read means there was enough light. → Falso (It means there was not enough light.)
Loud enough to hear means loud in a sufficient way. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A day at the museum · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a grey afternoon in London. Dirk and Rui walk into a famous museum. Tall columns stand in the entrance hall. Visitors move slowly from room to room. A guide holds up a small flag. The friends start their tour.

“Rui, this exhibition is so popular that the queue went around the corner. I nearly gave up.” says Dirk. “I know, Dirk. It was such a long wait that I bought a coffee and read a whole chapter of my book.” says Rui. “Worth it, though. Look at that statue. It looks as if it could start walking at any moment.” says Dirk.
